decision.summary: The Federal Open Market Committee raised its target for the federal funds rate by 25 basis points to 5 percent.

changes.quote: The Federal Open Market Committee decided today to raise its target for the federal funds rate by 25 basis points to 5 percent.
changes.explanation: The Fed increased the benchmark interest rate by 25 basis points, bringing it to 5 percent.

changes.quote: Economic growth has been quite strong so far this year.
changes.explanation: The Committee noted that economic growth has remained strong throughout the year.

changes.quote: The Committee sees growth as likely to moderate to a more sustainable pace, partly reflecting a gradual cooling of the housing market and the lagged effects of increases in interest rates and energy prices.
changes.explanation: The Fed expects growth to slow down due to a cooling housing market and past increases in interest rates and energy prices.

changes.quote: The Committee judges that some further policy firming may yet be needed to address inflation risks but emphasizes that the extent and timing of any such firming will depend importantly on the evolution of the economic outlook as implied by incoming information.
changes.explanation: The Fed left the door open for additional interest rate hikes depending on how economic data evolves.

tone_quotes.quote: The Committee judges that some further policy firming may yet be needed to address inflation risks but emphasizes that the extent and timing of any such firming will depend importantly on the evolution of the economic outlook as implied by incoming information.
Still, possible increases in resource utilization, in combination with the elevated prices of energy and other commodities, have the potential to add to inflation pressures.

for_you.text: On a $5,000 card balance at about 13.3% APR, a 25 bp increase raises monthly interest by about $1.04.

Mortgages track the 10-year Treasury yield, not the fed funds rate. The 10-year was 5.13% and moved 0 bp on the day; if that move passed through, the payment on a new $300,000 30-year loan at 6.58% would not change.
High-yield savings rates usually follow the Fed partly; on $10,000 that means roughly $15.00 a year more in interest.
Unemployment was 4.7%, and employers added an average of 261k jobs a month over the prior 3 months.

for_country.text: CPI inflation was 3.6% over the past year (April 2006); core PCE inflation, the Fed's preferred gauge, was 2.4%, against a 2% goal.
Real GDP grew at a 5.5% annualized pace in the latest reported quarter.
The 2-year Treasury yield, the most Fed-sensitive market rate, moved +4 bp on the day.
The broad trade-weighted dollar moved -0.33% on the day.

card.whats_next: The statement signals that future rate decisions will depend on incoming economic information and inflation risks. An educational forecast model gives the probability of a hike at the next meeting as 91% with 9% for a hold.
